about:
VieMed Healthcare is headquartered in Lafayette, Louisiana, and was founded in 2006 by Casey Hoyt and Michael Moore. The company began on a foundation of friendship, loyalty, and a commitment to treating others right, ideals that continue to shape its culture as it expands across the United States.

The company delivers a range of in-home clinical services centered on respiratory care and disease management. Its licensed respiratory therapists provide 24/7 personalized care for conditions such as chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, neuromuscular diseases, and obstructive sleep apnea, using remote monitoring technologies and proprietary connected health platforms. VieMed also operates VieMed Healthcare Staffing (VHS), a Joint Commission–certified division that places clinical professionals in facilities and homes nationwide. Through its PACE program, the organization focuses on reducing exacerbations, readmissions, and emergency visits via one-on-one patient assessments. As a publicly traded entity listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange and NASDAQ (VMD), VieMed operates a national family of brands serving thousands of patients.

VieMed serves patients directly — from infancy through end of life — as well as healthcare organizations, providers, and payers seeking staffing solutions or disease management partnerships. Its clinical teams include respiratory therapists, licensed clinical social workers, and healthcare administrators who coordinate care across the continuum.

The company distinguishes itself through a high-tech, high-touch model that combines proprietary remote monitoring with in-person clinician visits. Its comprehensive disease management approach aims to lower hospitalization rates, improve patient satisfaction, and reduce overall costs, while its staffing division holds Joint Commission accreditation as a mark of quality.
